title: The question-form check on a page item's PowerShell `command` refuses `gh api x | jq .` and `| less`, though jq.exe and less.exe run in PowerShell
why: Source: lane rebase-wave-1c, 13:32 CST Nov 16 (relay; triage read no diff): the round 1 reviewer's finding 4 on #3583 (judgment, not blocking). #3583 changed hooks/question_form.py PS_BASH_FORMS so a PowerShell `command` that pipes to a Unix tool on its list (jq, less, head, tail, grep) is refused, though jq.exe and less.exe run in PowerShell when installed. Printed text (COMMAND_REASON, rule command-in-item): "powershell command holds a bash operator", then the named forms. On main since 13:20:33 CST (merge 4680473b0). No refusal of the exact command was printed to the lane or runner 10; the coordinator's earlier account (a refusal in a lane) was this check's design, not a seen refusal. Effect: a page item's PowerShell command with `| jq .` is refused at the writer, so triage cannot give the owner that form. Not measured: how often page items need such a pipe.
note: Ready. Brief: decide whether jq and less belong on the PS_BASH_FORMS Unix-tool list (they run as jq.exe and less.exe when installed; head, tail and grep do not exist in PowerShell 5.1 as such), then fix or re-point the list with a test, red then green. Reader: the owner of question_form.py; decision question-form. Departs from: main refuses `| jq .` in a PowerShell command; the fix would allow it. Source of the claim not read by triage.
